summary.text: Amelia Rabroker is the Democratic candidate for Texas House District 55 in the November 3, 2026 general election, challenging incumbent Republican Hillary Hickland.
She is an artist who earned a bachelor's degree from Baylor University in 2003.

paragraphs.text: Rabroker has worked as an artist.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she raised her family in Central Texas, taught in its schools and built a small business.
Rabroker said she is launching a "Trust Texans Initiative" that would let Texans vote directly on laws that affect them.
She named education, mental health and veterans as her policy priorities.
